channel.title: Tech Opinions Digest
channel.description: Daily tech opinions digest for Yun Zhou

item.title: Gary Marcus: Just say no to Anthropic's IPO
item.description: Anthropic is aiming for a valuation of up to $1.4 trillion despite never having made a profit (bar one subsidised quarter), carrying nearly $900B in future compute liabilities, and with Q3 growth already decelerating sharply from Q2.

item.title: Cory Doctorow: The EU should go big and hard over border IT failure
item.description: The EU's biometric border system (EES) is years late, double budget, and still stranding travellers in multi-hour queues — and the EU is suing contractors IBM, Atos and Leonardo in secret instead of making a public example of them.

item.title: Andrew Ng: AI Job Anxieties Meet AI Job Opportunities (The Batch #378)
item.description: LinkedIn data shows AI has helped create 2 million jobs; Ng's case for embedding AI engineers inside marketing, HR and finance teams to build workflow automations, rather than keeping them siloed in engineering.
